title: The Right Fact, the Wrong Decision: SciValidityBench for Scientific Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.34767v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most agent-memory benchmarks frame long-term memory as retrieval: can an agent recover the relevant record from a long and evolving history? Scientific agents face a stricter problem: a correctly remembered fact may still be invalid to use. The same reported test result can support confirmation when the outcome and stopping rule were fixed in advance, yet only exploration when the outcome was selected from twenty inspected results. We call this scientific use validity: whether remembered evidence is eligible to influence a decision under the state governing its interpretation. We introduce SciValidityBench, an executable benchmark factory with 64 TaskSpecs spanning five validity modules and six scientific domains. TaskSpecs couple generated experimental histories with scientific-state definitions, programmatic decision oracles, controlled interventions, and automatic scoring. translated_title: 正确的事实，错误的决策：面向科学智能体记忆的SciValidityBench基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.34767v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大多数智能体记忆基准将长期记忆视为检索问题：智能体能否从漫长且不断演进的历史中找回相关记录？科学智能体面临的是更严格的问题：一个被正确记住的事实可能仍然是不适合使用的。同一个报告的实验结果，当结果和停止规则事先固定时，可以支持“确认”决策；而当结果是从二十个被检查的结果中挑选出来时，则只应支持“探索”决策。我们将这一概念称为“科学使用有效性”：即在支配其解释的科学状态下，被记住的证据是否有资格影响决策。我们提出SciValidityBench，这是一个可执行的基准工厂，包含64个TaskSpecs，覆盖五个有效性模块和六个科学领域。TaskSpecs将生成的实验历史与科学状态定义、程序化决策判定器、受控干预和自动评分相结合。SciStateForge编译器-读取器框架将分布式（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出SciValidityBench——一个包含64个任务规格、覆盖五个有效性模块和六个科学领域的可执行基准工厂，用于评估科学智能体记忆中的“科学使用有效性”问题，即正确记住的证据在其科学状态下是否有资格影响决策。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SciValidityBench, an executable benchmark factory with 64 TaskSpecs spanning five validity modules and six scientific domains, to evaluate scientific use validity—whether correctly remembered evidence is eligible to influence a scientific agent's decision under the state governing its interpretation.
